Command: Do not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother's wife
Summary: One of the boundaries of Leviticus 18: do not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother's wife. The chapter forbids these unions as defiling, and warns that the land itself would spew out a people who practised them (Leviticus 18:24-28).
Commandment: Do not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother's wife
Application: Leviticus 18 marks God's people as holy and distinct, and the New Testament reaffirms sexual purity, honouring the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit (1 Corinthians 6:19-20; Hebrews 13:4).
Purpose: To mark God's people as holy and distinct (Leviticus 18) and, in the New Testament, to honor the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit (1 Corinthians 6:19-20).
